That is the division of labor here.

segments.text: I am going to paste a problem frame. It has seven parts: 1 the goal it serves, 2 the problem, 3 who is affected and what it costs them, 4 how it is handled today and the moment that stops working, 5 what fixed would look like (a changed state, never a solution), 6 my assumptions marked confirmed or unverified, and 7 what I do not know yet. This is a first draft. Most of my assumptions are unverified, and that is expected; I will check them over the next nine weeks. Your job is to be a skeptic who works in this situation, not an editor. Do not rewrite anything and do not suggest solutions. Do not list everything you notice.
